summary: Authenticated owner, viewer, and second-workspace browser journeys passed against a disposable local Supabase replay.

journeys.detail: Owner authenticated through the browser and ArtistOS provisioned the first workspace.
Owner created a release and its starter operational spine through the authenticated UI.
Owner completed a release task through the capability runtime-backed server action.
Owner created a source-visible Artist Brain v2 memory through the UI.
Owner created a deterministic cross-functional AI Manager plan through the UI.
Opportunity Intelligence and Approval Center rendered for the authenticated owner.
Viewer read shared release and Brain memory but was denied a direct authenticated write.
Independent user received a separate workspace and could not see or query owner release data.
Runtime actions persisted audit and idempotency receipts alongside business records.
